archetypes.name: Growth corner
archetypes.rule: high growth, low margin: g at or above the 75th percentile, m below the 25th

archetypes.name: Balanced upper quartile
archetypes.rule: score between the 75th and 95th percentiles, g and m both at or above the median

archetypes.name: Mature cash generator
archetypes.rule: g below the median, m at or above the 75th percentile

archetypes.name: Sub-40 grower
archetypes.rule: g between the median and the 75th percentile, m below the median

archetypes.name: Stalled
archetypes.rule: g and m both below the median

archetypes.name: Near-frontier elite
archetypes.rule: score at or above the 95th percentile (Paper 1's calibration anchor)

archetypes.name: Acquisition-driven compounder
archetypes.rule: a serial acquirer: Bending Spoons, reported against organic growth
